target_customer: B2B sales teams and reps that run outbound prospecting
problem: Sales reps spend most of their time finding prospects, researching buying signals and writing outreach by hand.

founders.name: Richard Lee
education: Brown University, degree in Applied Mathematics and Economics
founders.background_notes: From YC page: COO at BuildZoom.

founders.name: Ross Geiger
education: Brown University, BA Economics and East Asian Studies

competitors.name: ZoomInfo
competitors.what: Public B2B contact data and sales intelligence provider

technical_complexity.rationale: In 2022 the product combined data enrichment, CRM integration and outreach drafting; the LLM era made drafting easy later, so it was standard engineering at founding.

defensibility.rationale: Prospecting tools were abundant and copyable; contact data came from third party providers.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents added AI features; Ciro itself was bought by Reevo, announced July 2026, with terms undisclosed.

market_need_then: Outbound prospecting was a large budget line with established vendors; Ciro raised a seed within months of the batch and YC jobs page says it was cash flow positive.

branding.domain_note: Uses ciro.io; acquisition history not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short, direct, confident with sales jargon; More pipeline. Less work.

brand_strength.rationale: Many unrelated companies share the name Ciro, and no press covers the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Ciro raised a 3.8 million seed from CRV, Y Combinator and SV Angel in October 2022, and reached a modest scale with hundreds of sales teams per a founder post. A crowded AI prospecting market led to its acquisition by Reevo in July 2026, a soft consolidation exit with undisclosed terms rather than a standalone breakout.
notes: Seed amount comes from the title of the company's own blog post as seen in search results; the post body was not retrieved, and the October 2022 date comes from search summaries (CB Insights reports 4.3M total across two rounds, unverified second round). Directory status says Active, but a press release and the site say acquired by Reevo. Competitors Apollo, ZoomInfo and Clay are named on the company site with no date; they existed before the batch but the source is undated. Product at founding in 2022 may have differed from the current AI agent pitch; no dated pivot found.
